meta_title: Taxi by Heznpc — A Local AI Workspace
meta_description: A local workspace for coordinating AI sessions and tools. macOS source preview with task handoffs, model preferences and governed Mac tools.
hero_tagline: A local workspace for coordinating AI sessions and tools.
hero_sub: Task Dashboard, session handoffs, phase model preferences and governed Mac tools. Build from source on macOS.
platforms_sub: Read-only Codex execution; imported sessions are observation-only. Autonomous execution, external resume and compression relay are planned.
modules_sub: Native. Fast. Built on AppleScript and Apple frameworks.
mod_notes_p: Create, search, and manage Apple Notes.
mod_reminders_p: Manage lists, due dates, and priorities.
mod_tv_p: Browse and control Apple TV app.
mod_system_p: Dark mode, volume, WiFi, Bluetooth, and more.
mod_safari_p: Tabs, reading list, and page content.
mod_bluetooth_p: Scan, connect, and manage BLE devices.
mod_intelligence_p: Apple Intelligence writing tools and image generation.
detail_notes: Full Apple Notes integration — create, read, update, and delete notes and folders. Search by title or body content. Supports rich text and HTML note bodies.
detail_reminders: Complete Reminders management — create tasks with due dates, priorities, and recurrence. Manage lists, mark complete, and query overdue items.
detail_calendar: Calendar event management with EventKit — create, modify, and delete events. Check availability, list calendars, and handle recurring events.
detail_contacts: Access the macOS Contacts database — search by name, email, or phone. Create and update contact records with full field support.
detail_mail: Read, compose, send, and manage email through Apple Mail. Search messages, handle attachments, and manage mailboxes.
detail_messages: Read recent iMessage conversations and send messages. Access chat history and manage conversations.
detail_music: Control Apple Music playback — play, pause, skip, shuffle, repeat. Manage playlists, search the library, and get now-playing info.
detail_photos: Access the Photos library — browse albums, search by date or keyword, get photo metadata and file paths.
detail_tv: Browse and control the Apple TV app — search content, manage the watch list, and control playback.
detail_podcasts: Browse podcast shows and episodes. Control playback, manage subscriptions, and search the podcast catalog.
detail_system: System-level controls — toggle dark mode, adjust volume and brightness, check battery, manage WiFi and Bluetooth, clipboard, notifications, and more.
detail_finder: File system operations through Finder — browse directories, move, copy, rename, trash files, and get file info.
detail_safari: Safari browser automation — manage tabs, access reading list, get page content, execute JavaScript, and manage bookmarks.
detail_screen: Capture screenshots and screen recordings. Take full-screen, window, or region captures with configurable output.
detail_maps: Search locations, get directions, and calculate distances using Apple Maps. Drop pins and manage favorites.
detail_shortcuts: Run Shortcuts automations, list available shortcuts, get shortcut details, and manage the Shortcuts library.
detail_intelligence: Apple Intelligence integration (macOS 26+) — writing tools for proofreading, rewriting, and summarization. Image generation with Image Playground.
detail_ui: Accessibility-based UI automation — inspect UI elements, click buttons, read text, and interact with any app's interface.
step1_desc: Install dependencies and compile the local runtime.
step2_desc: Record task phases, model preferences and child-session handoffs.
step3_desc: Inspect results and evidence; provider completion is not goal completion.
config_desc: After building, replace the absolute path with your checkout and add this local entry to your MCP client.
bs_sub: Built-in skills and tools require the relevant modules, permissions and explicit setup. Event triggers are configured workflows, not a general autonomous agent.
bs_1_title: Turn newsletter inbox into a to-do list
bs_1_desc: The sender-to-tasks skill can turn matching mail into follow-up reminders, with per-item retry and configured approval controls.
bs_2_title: A journal that writes itself when you walk away
bs_2_desc: After enabling the evening-winddown skill and its trigger, screen locking can gather events and reminders and create a journal note, subject to runtime permissions and approval policy.
bs_3_title: Today's events + due reminders on one timeline
bs_3_desc: One tool call — timeline_today — renders an interactive 6am→10pm axis that fuses Calendar and Reminders into a single view with an Unscheduled rail on the right. No more flipping between two apps.
bs_4_title: Copy a URL, land in Reading List — automatically
bs_4_desc: After enabling clipboard-url-to-reading and its trigger, a copied URL can be queued in Safari Reading List. Required modules, permissions and approval policy still apply.
bs_5_title: Ask your Mac what the AI did this week
bs_5_desc: Inspect locally retained tool-call evidence with audit_summary and audit_log. Audit metadata does not automatically verify the whole task; redact diagnostics before sharing.
wf_sub: Pre-built prompts that orchestrate multiple Apple apps together.
wf_daily: Summarize today's events, due reminders, unread mail, and recent notes.
wf_weekly: Review the past week and plan ahead.
wf_meeting: Pull event details, search notes, build context.
wf_research: Research topics using Safari, save findings to Notes.
wf_focus: Check conflicts, prioritize reminders, manage music.
wf_file: Scan a folder, categorize, summarize in Notes.
wf_followup: After a meeting, create follow-up notes and action items automatically.
why_title: Sessions, models and tools in one workspace.
why_sub: Keep the work and its execution boundaries together.
why_1_desc: Task Dashboard connects session relationships, phase model preferences and governed MCP tools for Mac apps.
why_2_desc: Explicit permissions, per-call approval controls, audit evidence and an emergency stop govern execution.
why_3_desc: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, and every client that speaks the MCP protocol.
why_4_desc: EventKit, PhotoKit, HealthKit, and CoreLocation — real framework access, not just AppleScript.
why_5_desc: Build locally and inspect the implementation. A source release does not publish an npm package or signed installer.
install_sub: npm, Registry, MCPB downloads and a signed app installer are not yet published. Repository publication is separate from distribution.
install_mcpb_desc: Use npm run app:run from the checkout. Start the local runtime, then open Task Dashboard from the Taxi menu.
install_stdio_desc: Run npm ci and npm run build. Configure your client with node and the absolute path to dist/index.js.
install_app_note: Development app and MCPB builds are available from source. They are not a signed installer or published download; Pages deployment is separate.
install_note: Requires macOS and Node.js 22+. Native app builds also need the Xcode command-line toolchain.
